wand_specialization.name: Wand Specialization
wand_specialization.text: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

arcane_focus.name: Arcane Focus
arcane_focus.text: Increases your chance to hit with your Arcane spells by 1%.

improved_channeling.name: Improved Channeling
improved_channeling.text: Gives you a 20% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a 14% chance while casting Arcane Blast.

arcane_subtlety.name: Arcane Subtlety
arcane_subtlety.text: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 8 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 15%.

magic_absorption.name: Magic Absorption
magic_absorption.text: Increases all your resistances by 5 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

arcane_concentration.name: Arcane Concentration
arcane_concentration.text: Gives you a 2% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

arcane_resilience.name: Arcane Resilience
arcane_resilience.text: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 25% of your Intellect.

arcane_geometry.name: Arcane Geometry
arcane_geometry.text: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 3 yards.

arcane_impact.name: Arcane Impact
arcane_impact.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 2%.

arcane_blast.name: Arcane Blast
arcane_blast.text: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 95 to 104 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, the damage of all your other spells is increased by 10% and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 175%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 8 sec or until any other damage spell is cast.

arcane_shielding.name: Arcane Shielding
arcane_shielding.text: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 17% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 25%.

improved_counterspell.name: Improved Counterspell
improved_counterspell.text: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 2 sec.

arcane_meditation.name: Arcane Meditation
arcane_meditation.text: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

missile_barrage.name: Missile Barrage
missile_barrage.text: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles will fire every 0.5 sec.

presence_of_mind.name: Presence of Mind
presence_of_mind.text: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

arcane_mind.name: Arcane Mind
arcane_mind.text: Increases your Intellect by 2% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 20%.

arcane_instability.name: Arcane Instability
arcane_instability.text: Increases the damage done by all your spells by 1% and your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.

arcane_power.name: Arcane Power
arcane_power.text: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

wake_of_fire.name: Wake of Fire
wake_of_fire.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 1 sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within 20 sec by 25%.

incineration.name: Incineration
incineration.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 2%.

improved_fireball.name: Improved Fireball
improved_fireball.text: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball and Frostfire Bolt spells by 0.1 sec.

ignite.name: Ignite
ignite.text: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 8% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

flame_throwing.name: Flame Throwing
flame_throwing.text: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 3 yards.

impact.name: Impact
impact.text: Gives your Fire spells a 3% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

burning_soul.name: Burning Soul
burning_soul.text: Gives your Fire spells a 23% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 10%.

improved_flamestrike.name: Improved Flamestrike
improved_flamestrike.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 5%.

pyroblast.name: Pyroblast
pyroblast.text: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 155 to 185 Fire damage and an additional 76 Fire damage over 12 sec.

improved_scorch.name: Improved Scorch
improved_scorch.text: Your Scorch spell has a 33% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

improved_fire_ward.name: Improved Fire Ward
improved_fire_ward.text: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 10% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

hot_streak.name: Hot Streak
hot_streak.text: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 15 sec. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

master_of_elements.name: Master of Elements
master_of_elements.text: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 10% of their base mana cost.

critical_mass.name: Critical Mass
critical_mass.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%.

blast_wave.name: Blast Wave
blast_wave.text: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 160 to 191 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

fire_power.name: Fire Power
fire_power.text: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2%.

combustion.name: Combustion
combustion.text: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 4 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

frost_warding.name: Frost Warding
frost_warding.text: Increases the Armor and resistance given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 15%. In addition, gives your Frost Ward a 10% chance to reflect Frost spells and effects while active.

improved_frostbolt.name: Improved Frostbolt
improved_frostbolt.text: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.1 sec.

elemental_precision.name: Elemental Precision
elemental_precision.text: Increases your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by 1%.

ice_shards.name: Ice Shards
ice_shards.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 20%.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.text: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 11% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 3%.

improved_frost_nova.name: Improved Frost Nova
improved_frost_nova.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 2 sec.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.text: Gives your Chill effects a 5% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

piercing_ice.name: Piercing Ice
piercing_ice.text: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 2%.

frost_channeling.name: Frost Channeling
frost_channeling.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 5% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 10%.

ice_lance.name: Ice Lance
ice_lance.text: Deals 28 to 33 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

improved_blizzard.name: Improved Blizzard
improved_blizzard.text: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 15% for 1.5 sec.

arctic_reach.name: Arctic Reach
arctic_reach.text: Increases the range of your Frostbolt and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 10%.

ice_block.name: Ice Block
ice_block.text: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.text: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 17%.

improved_cone_of_cold.name: Improved Cone of Cold
improved_cone_of_cold.text: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 12%.

cold_snap.name: Cold Snap
cold_snap.text: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

fingers_of_frost.name: Fingers of Frost
fingers_of_frost.text: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 1 spell cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

winter_s_chill.name: Winter's Chill
winter_s_chill.text: Gives your Frost damage spells a 20% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the chance your Ice Lance and Frostbolt spells will critically hit the target by 2% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 1 times.

ice_barrier.name: Ice Barrier
ice_barrier.text: Instantly shields you, absorbing 431 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.
